name: Use a Recovery Code
summary: A user with an outstanding TOTP MFA requirement chooses recovery-code authentication and the client opens the recovery-code entry surface without changing authentication state.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.continue.totp is visible for an already identified durable identity with an outstanding password-issued MFA challenge

postconditions.expression: session-capability remains anonymous, the same short-lived MFA challenge remains available, and auth.continue.recovery is visible for the same identified durable identity

sourceReferences.note: Angular exposes action:use-recovery-code and preserves the session-scoped MFA challenge while navigating to auth.continue.recovery.
React Native exposes action:use-recovery-code and preserves the in-memory MFA challenge while navigating to /auth/continue/recovery.
UI-only navigation scenarios are authored complete when canonical finders, deterministic destination, and stable-client source evidence are defined; runtime UI execution remains separate.
